name: pay
text: A customer takes a small step diagonally forward toward the market counter to pay. At the closer position the RIGHT hand reaches forwards and down to place money on the clear front ledge of the counter. Pause briefly in contact, then withdraw the hand and take a small step back to the original relaxed standing position. The left arm hangs naturally. Keep the hand above the counter, never reach through its front panel or the goods boxes.
